style: STRICT 2D PIXEL CHIBI, cozy office-game worker, top-down three-quarter camera. Big head at least one third of total body height, head and hat approximately 20 logical pixels tall out of a 46-pixel full-body height. Very big readable expressive eyes, each at least 3x4 logical pixels with ONE conspicuous WHITE catchlight pixel; NEVER plain dot eyes. Hat MUST leave generous visible face area and exposed hairline. Warm readable palette with 3-4 hard-edged tones per material, dark brown selective one-pixel outlines, deliberately chunky square pixel clusters. No gradients, anti-aliasing, smooth vector contours or dithering. Design approximately 28x46 logical pixels for a 32x64 cell; keep the broad hat inside 28-pixel width and every prop inside the cell. Full body, no clipping. Pure uniform magenta #FF00FF background, no magenta/pink/purple in subject. No furniture, scenery, shadow, floor, letters, punctuation, floating marks, detached pixels or steam. Calm adult botanist with a slim pear-shaped apron silhouette and short sturdy legs. Very wide honey-straw sunhat with a shallow crown, olive ribbon, and a cluster of THREE ivory daisies with golden centers on her anatomical left brim. Hat brim tips gently curl upward: keep the entire open forehead and eyes visible, never shadow-covered. Deep umber hair, clear curved hairline and ONE long thick braid hanging over her anatomical left shoulder to the waist, tied with an ochre band; the braid is visible from sides and back. Warm medium olive-peach skin, rosy cheeks, large expressive dark-brown oval eyes with bright WHITE square highlights. Serene small smile. Sage rolled-sleeve work shirt under a moss-green bib apron with TWO square tool pockets, cream seed packet and small silver trowel tucked into a pocket. Sand-colored work trousers with rolled cuffs and chunky dark forest-green rubber boots. Keep all these layers, hat flowers, single braid, eye highlights and pockets identical across every pose.
